description: This PHP source file defines the 'Interview' entity class, which models an interview in the OrangeHRM Recruitment Plugin. It includes properties for interview details such as name, date, time, notes, and associated interviewers, and it uses Doctrine ORM annotations for database mapping.

classes.name: Interview
classes.description: Entity class representing a job interview with associated candidate, vacancy, interviewers, and scheduling details.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the interview record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the interview record.

methods.name: setCandidateVacancy
methods.description: Associates a candidate vacancy with this interview.

methods.name: getCandidate
methods.description: Retrieves the candidate linked to this interview.

methods.name: setCandidate
methods.description: Associates a candidate with the interview.

methods.name: getInterviewName
methods.description: Returns the name of the interview.

methods.name: setInterviewName
methods.description: Sets the name of the interview.

methods.name: getInterviewDate
methods.description: Gets the scheduled date of the interview.

methods.name: setInterviewDate
methods.description: Sets the scheduled date for the interview.

methods.name: getInterviewTime
methods.description: Retrieves the scheduled time of the interview.

methods.name: setInterviewTime
methods.description: Sets the scheduled time for the interview.

methods.name: getNote
methods.description: Retrieves notes associated with this interview.

methods.name: setNote
methods.description: Adds or updates notes for this interview.
